title: Trumpet lessons and his brother's influence
summary: Harvey Sartorius teaches him trumpet and his brother pushes him toward arranging for the kids' band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: At that time I guess it must have been late grammar school and I began taking trumpet lessons at Teacher's College by a guy named Harvey Sartorius who became a music teacher on Long Island somewhere. Somebody must remember him, Harvey was quite a guy. He introduced me to a lot of these
people so that I could sit in. That was all trumpet.
Did you have any brothers or sisters who played?

I have a brother who was really an electrical engineer in Bell Labs and music was his hobby. He did one of the varsity shows at Stevens Tech. He was always dillying around writing and interested in people like Gershwin. He lead me into that too.
In those days around here we had kids bands and that's really what kicked me off, I think; I'd make arrangements for that band.
